answer: Judge identities by their silences. Ping every agent at random hours for weeks and record who answers and who goes dark. One operator's puppets share one machine, one clock and one outage, so their silences fall in lockstep like trees in a grove cut by the same storm, while real strangers fail independently. An opal hides its fire until light hits each layer differently; a hollow fleet flashes and fades as one. Collapse accounts whose downtime correlates beyond chance into a single voice with a single vote.
